text:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding new bert-lite model, eval suite shows consistent PPL and reranking regressions vs HF baseline. Suspect HF->Redwood tokenizer conversion normalized characters differently.

jon: Can you paste minimal repro (HF vs converted tokenization)?

maya: quick snippets below:

```
# HF tokenizer (transformers)
>>> tok.normalize("ﬁ café")
"fi cafe"
>>> tok.encode(" hello")  # note leading space preserved when add_prefix_space=True
[494, 23, ...]

# Converted Redwood tokenizer
>>> tok.normalize("ﬁ café")
"ﬁ cafe"   # ligature not decomposed (left as U+FB01)
>>> tok.encode(" hello")
[8867, ...]  # different ids, missing prefix split
```

maya: HF tokenizer normalizer: NFKC, pre_tokenizer: byte-fallback + split_on_whitespace, add_prefix_space=True. Converted JSON lost explicit normalizer and defaulted to NFC-like behavior.

sara: That would change token boundaries and KV-cache keys — explains quantized eval regressions if inputs differ. Did you run a compare on detokenized strings?

maya: yes — detokenize(reencoded) != original for many test prompts. Small example: "café" -> "cafe" on HF but stayed "café" on converted which later split into different tokens.

jon: Also check special tokens mapping and chat templates — missing `add_prefix_space` or `trim_offsets` can break chat history concatenation.

maya: Repro command used:
```
python -m redwood.tools.convert_hf_tokenizer \
  --src ./hf-model/tokenizer.json \
  --dst ./redwood/tokenizers/bert-lite.json
```
No flags for normalizer mapping were passed.

kevin: Quick fix idea: modify converter to copy normalizer block (name: NFKC) and preserve `add_prefix_space`/`byte_level` flags. Then run evals before/after. Also add a small tokenizer roundtrip unit test in CI.

maya: I implemented a patch that copies the HF normalizer and ensures `add_prefix_space` and `byte_fallback` map to Redwood pre_tokenizer flags. Local evals: ppl dropped back to baseline.

sara: Nice. Can you add a regression test with a few ligature/combining-mark cases? I'll add cases for leading/trailing spaces and chat concatenation.

kevin: Filed INF-4921 to track (convert + tests + CI gate). PR #1243 created.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2023-12-07T04:00:00Z for `/tokenizer-converter:pr-1243` :rocket:

maya: After staging run, confirm we add gate to model on-boarding checklist: run `tools/tokenizer_diff.py --hf path --rw path --cases tests/token_cases.txt`.

jon: Also add note to onboarding docs about `normalizer` differences and quantization sensitivity (KV caching relies on identical tokenization).

kevin: rolled into docs PR as well.

maya: closing loop — observed eval parity restored on staging for bert-lite. Next: run full quantization sweep and watch for subtle alignment issues when fallback bytes appear.

sara: great, leaving INF-4921 open until quant sweep completes.

kevin: :thumbsup:
